_about: Public-domain Kirsopp Lake, English New Testament scholar, professor at Leiden and then at Harvard, for the Word Hoard: The Text of the New Testament, The Historical Evidence for the Resurrection of Jesus Christ, The Early Days of Monasticism on Mount Athos, The Earlier Epistles of St. Paul, The Stewardship of Faith, and Landmarks in the History of Early Christianity. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 132 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

lake-text-of-nt: The text of the New Testament (London : Rivingtons, 1901)
lake-resurrection: The historical evidence for the resurrection of Jesus Christ (London, Williams & Norgate; New York, G.P. Putnam's Sons, 1907)
lake-monasticism-athos: The early days of monasticism on Mount Athos (Oxford, The Clarendon press, 1909)
lake-earlier-epistles: The earlier Epistles of St. Paul, their motive and origin (London, Rivingtons, 1911)
lake-stewardship-of-faith: The stewardship of faith, our heritage from early Christianity (New York, London, G.P. Putnam's Sons, 1915)
lake-landmarks: Landmarks in the history of early christianity (catalogued 1920)

_excluded.lake-translations: his Loeb Apostolic Fathers is a translation of other men's texts; the Codex Sinaiticus and Hermas facsimiles are editions
_excluded.lake-dups: other scans of the same books

_pending.lake-beginnings: The Beginnings of Christianity, Part I (1920, IA beginningschrist01unknuoft), edited with F. J. Foakes Jackson, essays by several writers (waits for Adam's ruling on many-author compilations)
